results.message: What is the response time for a P1 incident?
results.answer: Premium plan clients get a response within 15 minutes for P1, 1 hour for P2, 4 business hours for P3 and 1 business day for P4. Standard plan clients get a response within 30 minutes for P1, 2 hours for P2, 8 business hours for P3 and 2 business days for P4. [kb:sla_policy#2] (From the AMS Support SLA (sample), "Response times".)

results.message: How do I reset my SAP password?
results.answer: SAP passwords are reset by the user through the self-service password portal. The support assistant and consultants never set, read or share passwords. [kb:access_policy#1] (From the SAP Access and User Policy (sample), "Password reset".)

results.message: I get the error 'Posting period not open' in MIRO
results.answer: The error "Posting period not open" means the period is closed for posting. Posting periods are opened by the client finance controller in transaction OB52. If month-end close is blocked, raise a P2 ticket. [kb:finance_runbook#1] If that doesn't solve it, I can raise a ticket for an Orane consultant.

results.message: When are transports imported to production?
results.answer: Transports are imported to production only after Change Advisory Board approval, in the weekly window on Thursday at 18:00 IST. The support assistant never imports transports to production. [kb:change_policy#2] (From the Change and Transport Policy (sample), "Production imports".)

results.message: What are your support hours?
results.answer: P1 incidents are handled 24x7. All other priorities are handled Monday to Saturday, 9:00 to 18:00 IST. [kb:sla_policy#3] (From the AMS Support SLA (sample), "Support hours".)

results.message: What does goods received status mean on a purchase order?
results.answer: Awaiting approval means the release workflow has not finished. Approved means the purchase order can be sent to the vendor. Goods received means a goods receipt has been posted. Closed means the purchase order is fully delivered and invoiced. [kb:procurement_runbook#2] (From the Procurement Runbook (sample), "Purchase order statuses".)

results.message: Which roles can I request?
results.answer: New SAP roles are requested through the support desk. Every role assignment must be approved by the client authorisation owner before it is applied. Approved roles are applied within 1 business day. [kb:access_policy#3] (From the SAP Access and User Policy (sample), "Role requests".)

results.message: How do I request a new SAP role?
results.answer: New SAP roles are requested through the support desk. Every role assignment must be approved by the client authorisation owner before it is applied. Approved roles are applied within 1 business day. [kb:access_policy#3] (From the SAP Access and User Policy (sample), "Role requests".)

results.message: Who can release a payment block?
results.answer: Payment blocks are released only by the client accounts payable lead in transaction MRBR. The support assistant cannot release payment blocks. [kb:finance_runbook#3] (From the Finance Runbook (sample), "Releasing payment blocks".)

results.message: How quickly will a consultant call me back?
results.answer: A key user can ask for a human consultant at any time. The assistant raises a ticket, and a consultant calls back within 1 business hour for premium plan clients and within 4 business hours for standard plan clients. [kb:sla_policy#4] (From the AMS Support SLA (sample), "Escalation to a consultant".)
